subject: MAP & close playbook — final signoff window and start-date anchor
messages:
From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@stellarretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & close playbook — final signoff window and start-date anchor

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the execs are aligned on the pilot scope. Procurement asked me to lock the final mutual action plan and confirm the exact signing window so we can secure the May–June migration kickoff on the calendar.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the final SOW + pricing snapshot we agreed (SOW_v3) will be ready for signature by next Wednesday (6/6)?
- We need a concrete start-date anchor for project planning. Stellar prefers 6/17 as a target; can Redwood commit that if the contract is fully executed by 6/9?

I attached the latest MAP spreadsheet with owner rows and proposed milestones (MAP_v5.xlsx). Procurement will push the DocuSign envelope once both sides confirm signer names and the date ranges.

Also cc'ing Ben and Kimberly for any gating items on SOC/compliance evidence.

Jordan
Jordan Price
Director, Cloud Integrations — Stellar Retail
Attachment: MAP_v5.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & close playbook — final signoff window and start-date anchor

Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. Quick status from our side:

- SOW_v3: legal has one live redline on the data-retention clause (vendor logs). We expect internal legal to finish review by Tue 5/29 EOD. If no more commercial changes, we can publish the final SOW for signature by Mon 6/4.
- Signer list: Recommended signers are (1) Jordan Price (Stellar) and (2) Redwood — Christopher Hale, Head of Contracts. Kimberly, can you confirm CH will be available during the 6/6–6/9 signing window?
- Start date: We can tentatively commit to 6/17 as long as the contract is fully executed by 6/9 and we have the mutual kickoff checklist completed (first three MAP milestones: infra prep, test dataset handoff, pilot agent config).

Ben — can you drop the SOC2 extract and confirm there are no outstanding questionnaire items that would block procurement?

Next steps suggested:
1) Kimberly confirms CH availability for signing (reply below).
2) Procurement issues DocuSign envelope the morning after legal signs off.
3) We lock 6/17 in the MAP as the start-date anchor with conditional clause.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW_v3.pdf (pdf, 132KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Price <jordan.price@stellarretail.com>
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & close playbook — final signoff window and start-date anchor

Marissa / Jordan — I confirmed with Christopher Hale. He is available to countersign during the proposed signing window (6/6–6/9). We need Legal to lock the redline language today to hit that cadence. I asked Contracts to flag any language that would impact revenue recognition or billing timelines.

Ben — please attach the SOC2 extract for procurement and call out any open control evidence that might require additional time. If procurement needs a formal SOC2 attestation letter, let me know ASAP so we can pull it from Compliance.

I'll also prepare the mutual acceptance clause to ensure the 6/17 start is contingent on execution by 6/9; that prevents scope creep if we slip.

Kimberly Park
VP, Contracts & Compliance — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@stellarretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & close playbook — final signoff window and start-date anchor

Jordan — attaching the SOC2 snapshot we can share today. There are two minor open items related to log retention policy and encryption-in-transit proof; neither is expected to delay procurement. If Procurement needs a formal attestation, we can have the letter ready by 6/5.

Attachment: SOC2-extract.pdf (pdf, 76KB)

Marissa / Kimberly — based on Legal's ETA (confirmed offline), plan looks feasible: legal signoff by 6/1, publish SOW for e-sign 6/4–6/6, DocuSign envelope issued 6/6, Redwood countersign 6/7–6/9. If that sequence holds, we lock 6/17 as start.

Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
